program: Starttiraha (granted by the local employment authority, here Helsingin työllisyyspalvelut; law 380/2023 99-101 §; TE offices abolished 1.1.2025)
stopper_list: S1 RULES HER OUT: application must reach the employment authority before full-time business starts; no retroactive grant, only a continuation period is excepted (https://www.finlex.fi/fi/lainsaadanto/2023/380 100 § 2 mom 3 k; https://tyomarkkinatori.fi/lisatietoa-palveluista/starttiraha; https://www.hel.fi/fi/yritykset-ja-tyo/perusta-yritys/starttiraha)

S2 Apply to own employment area's authority (Helsinki: Helsingin työllisyyspalvelut, Helsinki residents), not a TE office, in Työmarkkinatori Asiointi with own strong identification (https://tyomarkkinatori.fi/lisatietoa-palveluista/starttiraha; https://www.hel.fi/fi/yritykset-ja-tyo/perusta-yritys/starttiraha)

S3 Business must be full time and continuous, in Finland; applicant lives in Finland (https://www.finlex.fi/fi/lainsaadanto/2023/380 99 §; https://www.hel.fi/fi/yritykset-ja-tyo/perusta-yritys/starttiraha)
S4 Sufficient readiness: training, experience, skills (https://www.finlex.fi/fi/lainsaadanto/2023/380 100 § 1 mom 1 k)

S5 Prerequisites for continuous profitable business; financing, premises, permits arranged (https://www.finlex.fi/fi/lainsaadanto/2023/380 100 § 1 mom 2 k; https://www.hel.fi/fi/yritykset-ja-tyo/perusta-yritys/starttiraha)

S6 Refused if the business already secures a reasonable livelihood or other income/benefit secures it (https://www.finlex.fi/fi/lainsaadanto/2023/380 100 § 2 mom 1 k; https://www.hel.fi/fi/yritykset-ja-tyo/perusta-yritys/starttiraha)
S7 Refused if it distorts competition more than marginally (https://www.finlex.fi/fi/lainsaadanto/2023/380 100 § 2 mom 2 k; https://www.hel.fi/fi/yritykset-ja-tyo/perusta-yritys/starttiraha)

S8 Refused for material tax/statutory-charge arrears or payment defaults; credit checked (https://www.finlex.fi/fi/lainsaadanto/2023/380 100 § 2 mom 4 k; https://www.hel.fi/fi/yritykset-ja-tyo/perusta-yritys/starttiraha)

S9 Granted as de minimis aid; form requires declaring de minimis aid of the past three years (https://www.finlex.fi/fi/lainsaadanto/2023/380 99 §; https://sa01elysuomifilomakkeet.blob.core.windows.net/blobsuomifilomakkeet/keha/keha20j1_fi_hakemus_starttiraha.docx s. 7)

S10 Mandatory attachments: business plan with financing, sales and profitability calculations, tax certificate, proof of financing, CV; positive decision requires all (https://www.hel.fi/fi/yritykset-ja-tyo/perusta-yritys/starttiraha; https://sa01elysuomifilomakkeet.blob.core.windows.net/blobsuomifilomakkeet/keha/keha20j1_fi_hakemus_starttiraha.docx s. 9)

S11 For an Oy: personal tax certificate and company tax-debt certificate, each at most three months old (https://sa01elysuomifilomakkeet.blob.core.windows.net/blobsuomifilomakkeet/keha/keha20j1_fi_hakemus_starttiraha.docx s. 9)

S12 Payment applied for monthly in arrears within two months of each period, or that month lapses (https://tyomarkkinatori.fi/lisatietoa-palveluista/starttiraha; https://www.hel.fi/fi/yritykset-ja-tyo/perusta-yritys/starttiraha)

B: T1: VAT registration mandatory if turnover exceeds 20 000 EUR 'tilikaudessa'; vero.fi measures it per calendar year (corrected by B in T2)
T1: apply 'noin 2-4 viikkoa' before start (Helsinki says about four weeks)
T1: processing 'tyypillisesti 1-4 viikkoa' (no official processing time published)
